title: Fulfilling Promise Orders upon Supplier GRN Delivery

intro.title: Fulfill Promise Orders
intro.subtitle: Convert out-of-stock backorders upon supplier inward GRN, notify patients, and bill

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 7, Part 2: Fulfilling Promise Orders upon Supplier GRN Delivery. In Phase 2, we booked out-of-stock medicine requests. Today, we fulfill them as soon as distributors deliver.
Go to Sales and select Promise Orders. The dashboard tracks all customer backorders with patient contact details, promised dates, and deposit advances.
When distributor stock arrives via inward GRN, MediFlow links received batches directly to pending promise orders, updating their status to Ready.
Click Notify Customer. An instant WhatsApp message informs the patient that their requested medicine is in stock and ready for collection.
Click Convert to Bill. All items and previous advance deposits transfer into the POS checkout for immediate handover. In Part 3, we schedule Chronic Patient Refills!

outro.takeaway: Promise Order Fulfillment: Automatically match inward distributor stock to customer backorders and notify patients for high retention.
